data.one_liner: Library for login with LinkedIn OAuth V2 service with OpenID Connect.
data.what_it_does: Provides Flutter widgets and services to authenticate users using LinkedIn OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect. It handles retrieving user profile details and authorization codes via a web view.
use_when: You need to implement Sign In with LinkedIn using OpenID Connect in your Flutter app.
You want to retrieve LinkedIn profile information and access tokens directly through widgets.
avoid_when: You are building a web application (web is not supported).
You require Firebase authentication integration out-of-the-box for LinkedIn.
strengths: Supports modern LinkedIn OpenID Connect authentication flow.
Provides ready-to-use widgets like LinkedInUserWidget and LinkedInAuthCodeWidget.
weaknesses: Web platform is not supported due to iframe and JS limitations.
data.setup_notes: Requires creating an app on LinkedIn developers console, configuring redirect URL, client ID, client secret, and checking minSdkVersion (at least 19 for Hybrid Composition).
